why: elongated lesion with pale grey centre and dark brown margin
yellowing around lesion on green rice leaf
actions: Avoid excessive nitrogen and keep field observations frequent
Remove infected crop residue where practical
Ask DAE before any pesticide use

why: brown discoloration with yellowish halo present
